lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - Point and say

details: Point and say requires students to match images to words. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for accurate pointing and production of the word or phrase.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - Listen to the conversation. Act it out.

details: Listen to the conversation exposes students to the structure: What do you do in the morning? and appropriate answers. It reviews the target language from the previous lesson. Act it out allows students to practise the target language in mime, showing understanding.
Look for careful listening, accurate pronunciation, stress and intonation, and participation.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - Read and tick. Then ask and answer

details: Read and tick requires students to understand the question and possible answers and respond personally. Ask and Answer gives students controlled practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for appropriate responses, neat bookwork, correct use of the question, clear answers and turn taking.
